items.summary: Recommendation: continue the existing bounded, reversible evidence and measurement work across 0xroulette.com, marineactivity.com, aliencouncil.com, fishhooklabs.com, stinkyleftfoot.com, and the other already-active site workstreams; create no duplicate queue tasks or production changes. The 30-day SEO window through 2026-09-23 recorded 13,177 impressions, 126 clicks, 932 sessions, and 13 conversions. Amazon reported $4.92 commission on 2026-09-21 from 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items; site-level margin and ROI are not calculable because one tracking ID is unmapped and direct costs are unavailable. The main unknown is which sites can produce attributable contribution margin without disproportionate build or renewal cost. Smallest next step: complete active baselines, smoke/reachability checks, and rollback notes, then measure deployed changes after 14 days or 100 new impressions. Candidate work for saveusfarms.com, xxxtea.com, deeppenetrations.com, broadwayshowgirls.com, greatamericanlakes.com, marineactivity.com, aliencouncil.com, fishhooklabs.com, stinkyleftfoot.com, 0daynews.com, and americastrikes.com is already active, filed, or blocked by existing routing; no new change request is justified. Owner question: for SearchWoot choose A) keep private, B) approve preparation of an unsent Woot permission request, or C) end the public-beta pursuit.
